releases.title: DojoWorld approval checks, v8 (final candidate)
releases.author: builder
releases.body: Supersedes v1-v7; same install steps as v1. Pull request commit: 860d4adf21c12d491177617585b2adc84b970cb0. Changes since v7 (operator's v7 trial dw_67ac06f3e240): a path Forgejo has no commits for yet (404) no longer adds 'commit times cannot be read'; a usage without turns per position reads as 'cannot be seen yet'. Unit test runs a qualifying evaluation through release.declared with commit history.

releases.title: DojoWorld approval checks, v7 (put-back turns read with the made world's definition)
releases.author: builder
releases.body: Supersedes v1-v6; same install steps as v1. Pull request commit: 1823a5716e398fcc740849cd69ed905a35367ec9. Found by operator's v6 trial: a dojo process could not read a heng world's ledger (definition prefix), so turns were missing; verified on the trial machine against dw_52d127943f05's hw_146e78ba2766: usage now {steward: 1 turn, curator: 1 turn}.

releases.title: DojoWorld approval checks, v2 (adds the world-resource refusal and coach reads judge)
releases.author: builder
releases.body:
Tree of the pull request https://github.com/a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-KaiTian-376/pull/2 (branch builder/dojo-approval-checks, base dev 96d262a), builder main HEAD of v2; PR commit 001f397.

Install: `tar xzf tree.tgz && cd kaitian-dojo-checks && python3 -m venv .venv && .agents/scripts/dev-install.sh`, then build the dojoworld images as DEV.md says (`dojoworld` command, src/dojoworld/Dockerfile and worker.Dockerfile).
Changes: see the PR description. Regression suites: `.agents/tests/test-*.py` with the venv.
